# ADR-3008: A01: Directory traversal path join for file lane 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unvalidated paths read outside the intended root.

## Decision

File handlers MUST NOT perform a directory traversal path join for file lane 8 (A01-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Resolve and confine paths before open.
